# Orgin | ارجین

> راهنمای فارسی ربات مدیریت گروه تلگرام ارجین. این فایل و README مخزن، اطلاعات جاری قابلیت‌ها و دستورها را خلاصه می‌کنند.

Orgin is a Telegram group-management bot with member moderation, content locks, anti-spam tools, welcome/rules, group growth features, statistics, premium options, and an AI assistant. Feature availability may depend on Telegram permissions, role, plan, and service availability.

## Source of truth

- Canonical complete feature and command guide: https://github.com/orginlabs/orgin-bot-documentation/blob/main/README.md
- Commands reference: https://github.com/orginlabs/orgin-bot-documentation/blob/main/docs/14-commands-reference.md
- FAQ: https://github.com/orginlabs/orgin-bot-documentation/blob/main/FAQ.md

## Links

- Bot: https://t.me/orginv1bot
- Support group: https://t.me/orginsupport
- Official channel: https://t.me/orginchanel
- Website: https://orginlabs.github.io/orgin-bot-documentation/
- Documentation repository: https://github.com/orginlabs/orgin-bot-documentation

## Notes

- This repository contains documentation, not the bot source code.
- Do not infer commands or features beyond the canonical README; availability can vary by role, plan, Telegram permissions, and service status.
